newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Tan in HK$273 mln shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Tan in HK$273 mln shr placement.

text.p: Guangdong Tannery Ltd said on Tuesday it would place 88 million new shares to parent Guangdong Investment Ltd, raising about HK$273.12 million net proceeds to strengthen its financial position for expansion.

Guangdong Investment has agreed to place 44 million existing Gaungdong Tannery shares at HK$3.15 each to professional and institutional investors before it subscribes for 88 million new Gaungdong Tannery shares at the same price, a statement said.
On completion of the placing and subscription, Guangdong Investment's stake in Guangdong Tannery will be reduced to 70.83 percent from 75 percent, it said.

Guangdong Tannery said about HK$70.92 million of the net proceeds would be used to buy a leather handbag business and HK$80 million would go to expanding production facilities and operations in China.
The company said another HK$36 million would be used to acquire new office premises and the balance would be for general working capital.
Trading in Guangdong Tannery shares, which was suspended on Monday, is due to resume on Tuesday.
Leather firm Guangdong Tannery was listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange in December 1996.
